asked.item: Can we get on a Zoom call (10 minutes)?
Is there a faster way than back-and-forth chat?

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that Blotato does not offer Zoom calls and describe how support works in the in-app chat.

steps.text: Blotato does not offer Zoom calls, phone calls, or live meetings with customers.
All support happens in the in-app chat, where the support team guides you step by step.
To speed things up, describe what you are trying to do and share screenshots or screen recordings of where you are stuck.
